items.name: Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025
items.information: Zapraszamy na Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – zawody stworzone specjalnie dla fanów konkurencji blindowych! 🙈 To wydarzenie to prawdziwy maraton: w programie znajdziecie wyłącznie blindy, a dodatkowo coś naprawdę rzadkiego – dwie rundy dużych kostek bez patrzenia. To świetna okazja, by sprawdzić swoją wytrzymałość, koncentrację i zmierzyć się z wyzwaniem, którego nie spotyka się na co dzień. Jeśli blindy to Wasza pasja (albo chcecie wreszcie poczuć ich klimat na poważnie) – widzimy się w Rzeszowie! --- We are excited to invite you to Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – a competition dedicated entirely to blindfolded events! 🙈 This is a true marathon: the schedule includes only blindfolded events, and on top of that something truly rare – two rounds of big cube blindfolded solving. It’s a perfect opportunity to test your endurance, focus, and face a challenge you don’t get to see very often. If blindfolded solving is your passion (or you simply want to dive into its atmosphere for real) – see you in Rzeszów!

items.name: Please Be Quiet Waterloo 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events*** and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Volos Wild Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIwODI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be406f2472acbf959e21897f27b9bdc0460b0ad7/536296154_1486549299105261_4236201959451164819_n.jpg) Το Volos Wild Open 2025 θα είναι ο διαγωνισμός με τα περισσότερα events στην Ελλάδα για το 2025 μέχρι στιγμής και ο πρώτος που θα γίνει ποτέ στην πόλη του Βόλου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του VALIS HOTEL για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) Volos Wild Open 2025 will be the competition with the most events in Greece for 2025 so far, and the very first ever held in Volos! In the conference hall of VALIS HOTEL, for 2 days, old and new, young and older Cubers from all over the country – and beyond – will meet again for our favorite hobby. Bring your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come join us for yet another celebration of cubing! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, both steps are required: 1. Completing the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** 2. Paying the registration fee with your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2025
items.information: **German** Liebe Speedcuber, liebe Würfelfans, wir freuen uns riesig, euch zum 1. Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende am 11. und 12. Oktober 2025 einzuladen! Zum ersten Mal wird in Wuppertal ein offizielles Speedcubing-Event stattfinden – und ihr könnt dabei sein! Euch erwartet ein spannendes Wochenende voller Drehspaß, Bestzeiten und einer großartigen Community. Egal, ob Newcomer oder erfahrener Cuber – jeder ist herzlich willkommen! Meldet euch an, seid dabei – wir freuen uns auf euch! **English** Dear speedcubers, dear cube fans, We are delighted to invite you to the 1st Wuppertal Cube Weekend on 11 and 12 October 2025! For the first time, an official speedcubing event will take place in Wuppertal - and you can be part of it! You can expect an exciting weekend full of fun, personal records and a great community. Whether you're a newcomer or an experienced cuber - everyone is welcome! Sign up, be there - we look forward to seeing you!

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2025, but is being hosted in several separate venues across the nation. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. There will be a short break in between attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

items.name: Graz Open 2025
items.information: ##### *English version is below* ​ #### **Deutsch:** ​ Speedcubing ist auch 2025 wieder zurück in Graz! Wir freuen uns wieder ein offizielles WCA Turnier in Graz zu veranstalten. ​ Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. ​ Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! ​ Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. ​ ​ Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ​ ----- ​ #### **English:** ​ Speedcubing is back in Graz! We are happy to announce another WCA Competition in Graz. ​ The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. ​ The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. ​ Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Trondheim Høst 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

FMC Tijuas III 2025 evoluciona con la llegada de Big Blind. Tres intentos, máxima concentración y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no importa la velocidad, sino la estrategia. ¿Te atreves a resolver sin ver? ¿Podrás encontrar la solución en menos movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most mind-focused challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas III 2025 levels up with the introduction of Big Blind. Three attempts, full concentration, and now blindfolded solving. It’s not about speed — it’s about precision and planning. Can you solve without sight? Can you find the most efficient solution? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE5NDI1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46efbd6ce97b12c0b1ff7f3842284a55a8a8a426/AACMHorizontal.png) 🇧🇷 A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. **ATENÇÃO**: Devido à limitação de espaço no local da competição, cada competidor poderá levar apenas 1 convidado, mediante o pagamento de uma taxa de R$10. Contamos com a compreensão e colaboração de todos para que o evento seja organizado, seguro e agradável para todos os participantes. **ATENÇÃO**: No ato da inscrição, solicitamos que seja informado um telefone de contato no campo de observações. Caso seja necessário levar um acompanhante responsável, registre também o nome completo dele nesse mesmo campo. --- 🇺🇸 The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes. **ATTENTION:** Due to space limitations at the competition venue, each competitor may bring only 1 guest, upon payment of a R$10 fee. We kindly ask for everyone’s understanding and cooperation so the event remains organized, safe, and enjoyable for all participants. **ATTENTION:** At the time of registration, please provide a contact phone number in the remarks field. If it is necessary to bring a responsible companion, also include their full name in the same field.

items.name: Ottawa Blindfolded 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Please be Quiet All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday September 19th 2025 at 10 pm (8 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Silence s'il vous plaît Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 19 septembre 2025 à 22h (8 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?feature=shared). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?feature=shared). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63182-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63181-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bde9ec161a7bab04eccdb3fc3331c34ff2b36f13/BAIANO%202025%20copiar.jpg) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Menores de 5 anos estão isentos de taxas ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ People under 5 years are exempt from the guest fee ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". items.information: ¡Llega a Puebla el torneo CUBING BUAP! Un encuentro único donde los mejores speedcubers del país (tú podrías ser uno de ellos) demostrarán su talento en una competencia de precisión, velocidad y estrategia. La categoría principal será nada más y nada menos que el legendario 3x3, el clásico que lo inició todo. Un cubo, seis colores y una sola meta: ¡resolverlo en el menor tiempo posible! Si eres un cubero experto que busca romper su récord o si estás dando tus primeros giros y quieres vivir la emoción de la competencia, CUBING BUAP es el escenario perfecto para ti. A unique gathering where the country's best speed cubers (you could be one of them) will showcase their talent in a competition of precision, speed, and strategy. The main category will be none other than the legendary 3x3, the classic that started it all. One cube, six colors, and one goal: solve it in the shortest time possible! Whether you're an expert cuber looking to break your record or are just taking your first spins and want to experience the thrill of competition, CUBING BUAP is the perfect venue for you. There will be prizes, giveaways, excitement, and of course... lots of cubes spinning at the same time!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU1MTQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cef753cc0422223e223e2696d2d751a45d058f8b/UKC25_LOGO_-_FOR_WCA_WEBSITE.jpg) ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2025! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MzYyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0266135e5081fb6c7c2e4bbc209d6826f5bea87/CEB%20logo.jpeg) ***Español*** **¡Hola Cubers! Somos Cubers te invita y te da la bienvenida al Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** La siguiente comptetencia oficial de speedcubing celebrada en el Auditorio "Plutarco Elías Calles" en el CEN del PRI ubicado en la colonia Buenavista, lugar de la antigua estación de ferrocarriles que conectaba con la mayoría de las rutas de Ferrocarriles Nacionales de México hasta 1997. Ven y desafía tus límites, pon a prueba tus habilidades, conoce muchas más personas con la misma pasión por el cubo, disfruta de las dinámicas que tenemos preparadas para ti y sobre todo prepárate para resolver tus puzzles de la manera más Express. Te esperamos en el Acceso 1 del CEN del PRI este 16 y 17 de agosto. ¡TODOS A BORDO DEL CUBING EXPRESS! *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)* ***English*** **Hello Cubers! Somos Cubers invites you and welcomes you to Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** The next WCA speedcubing competition will be held in the "Plutarco Elías Calles" Auditorium at the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) located in the Buenavista neighborhood, the site of the old train station that served most of the Mexican National Railways (FERROCARRILES NACIONALES DE MÉXICO) routes until 1997. Come and challenge your limits, test your skills, meet many more people with the same passion for cubing, enjoy the dynamics we have prepared for you, and above all, get ready to solve your puzzles in the most Express way possible. We'll see you at Access 1 of the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) this August 16th and 17th. ALL ABOARD THE CUBING EXPRESS! *This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)*

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5MDA1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9132d12b3f016881cae138be00b2a5b4b234d103/1000017045.jpg) Zapraszamy na piątą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w sześciu konkurencjach, w których szykuje się niezwykle zacięta rywalizacja. Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/). Zadanie publiczne współfinansowane jest ze środków [Samorządu Województwa Mazowieckiego](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). --- We invite you to the fifth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in six very competitive events. The competition will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with Przemysław Rogalski and Piotr Olszewski.

items.name: FMC Tijuas II 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1bebd0144612f93a0dcf3a3fe3a47b3623ad1272/image.png) Llega de nuevo a Tijuana el desafío más cerebral del speedcubing. FMC Tijuas II 2025 sube de nivel con la incorporación de Big Blind. Tres intentos, concentración total y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no gana quien corre más, sino quien piensa mejor. ¿Estás listo para enfrentarte al cubo sin verlo? ¿Estás listo para resolver con el menor número de movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most cerebral challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas II 2025 takes it further with the addition of Big Blind. Three attempts, total focus, and now blindfolded solving. Victory doesn’t go to the fastest, but to the smartest. Are you ready to solve without seeing? Are you ready to move with precision? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.name: Cape Cubes Winter 2025
items.information: Welcome to Cape Cubes Winter 2025! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days, with a brand new format where we will do all the rounds of each event in a row, then move onto another event. Please look at the Schedule to see what this looks like, and when your events are due to begin. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. On-the-spot registration will be accepted, but it is still a good idea to register and pay online. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ​ **SPONSOR** A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Cubestuff shop at the competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwODIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f6279e9aecc7732beb40546a8e15830a644dfd6/cubestufflogocolourv2-2048x800.png) ​ **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.name: CF Goes Crazy Brzeziny 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MDU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9099699a415c4020c460b8848aaf69949ce677ba/goes%20crazy%20wca.png) Drodzy, ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na jedyne w swoim rodzaju zawody side'owe! Chcemy dać Wam możliwość sprawdzenia swoich sił w konkurencjach blindowych oraz Big Cube'ach bez ciążącego na Was widma restrykcyjnych cut-offów, które zastąpione zostały wysokimi limitami kumulowanymi. Dzięki temu mniej zaawansowani zawodnicy będą mieli szansę na uzyskanie wyników których wcześniej nie byli w stanie osiągnąć! Oszaleliśmy? Być może 😉 Dear All, Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition! We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach! Have we Gone Crazy? Maybe 😉 ---- **WAŻNE / IMPORTANT** Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2) regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia. Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 4x4x4 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 5x5x5 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. 3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 4x4x4 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 5x5x5 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--01c41a8280fe19ef88356bbc5b97d7c710f9edd2/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png)](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575052693279) ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est la résolution optimisée, qui nécessite une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent faire le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions au Québec et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ### Club de speedcubing de l'Université Laval Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### (EN) ### Please be quiet The main event in this competition is the Fewest Moves Challenge, which requires a great deal of learning, practice and concentration. All those present, including participants and guests, are asked to make no noise to enable the participants to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to participate in the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in Quebec and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### Speedcubing Club of Université Laval Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwMTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--daef33d7ae3aafcc06a39fef90bb4a22af1db024/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-06-03%20at%2019.29.40.jpeg) **ENGLISH** Welcome to the Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! This official WCA competition will take place in the charming Pueblo Mágico of Paracho, Michoacán, a town known for its rich craftsmanship and warm cultural heritage. The event will be held during the internationally renowned Cantoya Balloon Festival, a celebration filled with color, creativity, and tradition that attracts visitors from around the world. This edition of the competition will feature the following official events: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx, and Skewb. It promises to be an unforgettable experience for both competitors and guests, blending the excitement of speedcubing with one of Mexico’s most vibrant cultural festivals. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/). **ESPAÑOL** ¡Bienvenidos al Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! Este torneo oficial de la WCA se llevará a cabo en el encantador Pueblo Mágico de Paracho, Michoacán, famoso por su tradición artesanal y su calidez cultural. La competencia se celebrará durante el reconocido Festival Internacional de Globos de Cantoya, un evento lleno de color, creatividad y tradición que reúne a visitantes de todo el mundo. En esta edición del torneo se disputarán las siguientes categorías oficiales: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx y Skewb. Será una experiencia inolvidable tanto para competidores como para acompañantes, combinando lo mejor del speedcubing con una de las celebraciones culturales más importantes de México. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f863d51aca44602df4916ae5a0e5ef1e278b5af/GO%202025.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**! **English** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik’s Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**!

items.name: Kristiansund Open 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kristiansund Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025#61112-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kristiansund Open 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KristiansundOpen2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNzc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2d27809f1784d7222b898a07b6f26a4355886a37/image.png) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ **Estudantes do Colégio Integral terão desconto na inscrição, pagando uma taxa de R$ 15,00 (quinze reais) caso se inscrevam antes da competição e R$ 20,00 (vinte reais) caso se inscrevam no dia da competição.** ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ **Colégio Integral students will have a descount. They will pay R$ 15.00 (fifteen brazilian reais) if they register prior to the competition and R$ 20.00 (twenty brazilian reais) if they register on the spot.**

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Sommerkubing 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025#59464-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Sommerkubing 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSommerkubing2025#59464-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Summer 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Linz Summer 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place at the main school hall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit both a physical and photo copy of your ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTY1NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--706ac75f6cf6972bc1df69e20afd1af3fd228aca/Todo%20o%20nada%20San%20Andr%C3%A9s%20Cholula%202025_500.png) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. ¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!** Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition. You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt. Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing! This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.** Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTcxOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b0423464106a5bf4730ca8189b9c1cd1a18f9149/Oslo%20Open%202025.PNG)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODcyMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--125495dffb084fd15e0ce7c77c8990bee39bc694/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το B' μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και Πυραμίδα ή 4x4 και 5x5 επιθυμείτε. Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα καλωσορίζοντας το καλοκαίρι για ακόμα μία φορά στο αγαπημένο μας πλέον Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **ATHENS SUMMER BREAK B 2025.** Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * 5x5 Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part B of a series of two competitions. items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 30 mai 2025 à 20h.** Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday May 30th, 2025 at 8 pm.** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Saint-Augustin B 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
